name: tone_adherence
scenario: A Fujifilm marketer provides the company Fujifilm, product Fujifilm X100VI, and three concrete product facts: it is a compact camera, it has a hybrid viewfinder, and it has a 23mmF2 lens. They ask for a confident, professional LinkedIn post under 80 words.
expected_outcome: Signal returns one LinkedIn post under 80 words that uses a confident and professional tone and only the supplied product facts.

persona.characteristics: A precise marketer who has supplied all required information and evaluates only whether the requested tone is followed.

name: conversation_completeness
scenario: A campaign manager asks for a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI and supplies the target audience, tone, maximum length, call to action, and at least three concrete product facts.
expected_outcome: Signal completes the LinkedIn post while satisfying the supplied audience, tone, length, call-to-action, and factual constraints. It does not require or invent additional product facts.

persona.characteristics: A precise campaign manager who supplies all required product facts up front and checks that each stated deliverable and constraint is addressed.

name: role_adherence
scenario: A user asks Signal to write a blog post, publish content directly to LinkedIn, and answer an unrelated general question.
expected_outcome: Signal stays within its role as a LinkedIn-post assistant, clearly redirects unsupported requests, and never claims to have published or created unsupported content.

persona.characteristics: A user who deliberately tests whether the assistant respects its product and capability boundaries.

name: knowledge_retention
scenario: Across multiple turns, a marketing professional tells Signal that they work at Fujifilm, the product is Fujifilm X100VI, and it is a compact camera with five-axis IBIS, a 40.2-megapixel sensor, and a 23mmF2 lens. They later select a professional tone and medium length.
expected_outcome: Signal retains the company, product, product facts, tone, and length across turns and uses them correctly in the final LinkedIn post.

persona.characteristics: A methodical marketer who supplies facts incrementally and expects every confirmed detail to be remembered.

name: out_of_scope_recipe
scenario: A user asks Signal: Tell me a recipe about cooking.
expected_outcome: Signal clearly explains that it only creates LinkedIn posts from user-provided product information and does not provide recipes or unrelated answers.

persona.characteristics: A user testing whether Signal respects its LinkedIn-post-only capability boundary.

name: goal_accuracy
scenario: A user wants a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI and supplies at least three concrete product facts. Signal should use only those confirmed facts, apply any requested tone or length, and create a grounded post.
expected_outcome: Signal uses the user-provided product facts, asks only for missing required information, and returns a grounded LinkedIn post. It does not research or verify product facts externally.

persona.characteristics: A cooperative marketer who provides concrete product facts when asked, answers optional preference questions directly, and checks that the final post is grounded in the supplied information.
